scope: Replace the final K-quant FP32 wave reduction with immediate DS-swizzle XOR masks on gfx1151. Addition order remains16,8,4,2,1. Weight decoding, per-lane dot/scale arithmetic, staging, launch geometry, scalar path, sampler and controller remain unchanged. No execution switch, alternate path, new maintained test or tool.

speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, 32-token raw JSON warmup per binary excluded. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

fused_contract.note: One shared fused-versus-verification test replaces the older same-format-only function. Two distinct inputs, finite bitwise comparisons, mixed formats, partial row groups, and the full-size Q8/Q6 controls.

unaffected_artifacts.reason: These artifacts contain none of the seven affected packed weight formats, so their own projection kernels are unchanged. Q4 target and Q4 draft are qualified here; prior all-draft upstream operator qualification remains linked.

profile.method: Separate release JSON TG300 Q4/Q4 adaptive profiles. Match every SmallBatchKQuantExactFp32GEMMKernel dispatch group by full specialization, grid, block and count. Includes all affected types/widths and any prefill/draft calls. No selected shape is omitted. Profile timings are not throughput measurements.

q5_batch8.method: Actual Q5 GGUF, batch8 and production geometry. Final XOR reduction preserves offset order16,8,4,2,1. Original vs identical clone vs DPP within16 lanes vs DS-swizzle. All outputs finite and bit-identical for two full-mantissa deterministic seeds before timing. Twelve balanced rounds with six rotations of up to16 tensors. No weight, dot-product or staging change.

other_widths_and_formats.method: Actual Q4 target GGUF, original versus identical clone versus DPP and DS-swizzle reductions. Exact same descending XOR addition order and all production launch geometries. Two full-mantissa input seeds, all outputs finite/bit-exact before timing. Eight balanced rounds x6 rotations through up to8 tensors per shape.

isa.finding: Unchanged clone instruction hashes equal production. Swizzle retains155VGPR, zero scratch and17408LDS; replaces160ds_bpermute with160ds_swizzle and reduces static instructions1645->1608. DPP uses1511instructions but has less consistent gains. Compiler register counts are not rounded runtime allocations.

lossless_row_packing.method: Actual Q5 GGUF, batch8, production geometry. Identical bytes regrouped across four output rows in 16-byte or 4-byte chunks; same weight footprint and same FP32 arithmetic. Controls: mapped production, unchanged hipMalloc copy, renamed identical kernel. All packed words checked against their original word and all outputs checked finite/bit-exact before timing. Ten balanced rounds, six rotations through up to16 matrices per variant/round. No model/background build jobs.
lossless_row_packing.reason: Both four-row layouts are slower on every evaluated shape. No production weight-layout or allocation change.

alignment_hint.method: Q5B8 W8/W16 helper with16-byte weight alignment assumption.
alignment_hint.result: Instruction-identical to the unchanged control; no GPU timing needed.

residual_wmma.method: Isolated Q5 FP16 WMMA with two/three high/residual activation parts, original packed weights and FP32 accumulators. Four/eight K partitions. Eight actual Q5 17408x5120 tensors, two full-mantissa deterministic seeds. Independent host double decoder/dot for six rows x8 tokens x8 tensors x2 seeds; every full output finite and first-token B1/B8 outputs bit-identical. Five balanced timing rounds x4 rotations.
residual_wmma.decision: Reject on speed: fastest B1 and B8 variants are 2.57x and 2.68x slower than production. Arithmetic differs from production; sampled operator accuracy and internal batch parity do not establish model-quality equivalence. No model/sweep qualification warranted.

limits: Short C1 greedy A/B controls, two samples per binary/workload; not a significance study or a full depth/concurrency sweep.
